en.headline: Red flags raised at five beaches over big waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department advised swimmers to stay out of the water at Stanley Main, Shek O, Big Wave Bay, Silverstrand and Clear Water Bay Second beaches.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced on Friday that red flags had been hoisted at five beaches because of big waves.
The affected beaches are Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach on Hong Kong Island, and Silverstrand Beach and Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung.
Beachgoers were advised not to swim at these locations. The department said the red flags indicate that swimming there would be dangerous under the current sea conditions.

zh.headline: 因大浪 五個泳灘懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署宣布港島南區及西貢共五個泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗，提醒市民勿在該處游泳。
body: 康樂及文化事務署今日（9月18日）宣布，由於大浪關係，港島南區的赤柱正灘泳灘、石澳泳灘及大浪灣泳灘，以及西貢區的銀線灣泳灘及清水灣第二灣泳灘已懸掛紅旗。
紅旗顯示在該處游泳會有危險，市民請勿在上述泳灘游泳。
康文署提醒泳客留意懸掛的旗號及海面情況，確保安全。
